content: IEEE Day 2025 is happening on October 7th, 2025. It's an annual celebration of IEEE's founding and achievements in advancing technology for humanity.
The event will be held at NSBM Green University. IEEE NSBM Student Branch, Computer Society Chapter, and Women in Engineering Affinity Group are organizing this celebration.
You can register online via this website. The registration includes access to all workshops, networking sessions, and refreshments throughout the day.
The event features exciting workshops on emerging technologies, keynote speakers from the industry, technical competitions, and networking opportunities with professionals and students.
IEEE Day 2025 theme focuses on innovation, technology advancement, and building connections within the IEEE community. Participants will learn about latest trends in engineering and technology.
The website for the IEEE Day 2025 at NSBM Green University was designed and developed by the beautiful people of the Development Team of IEEE Student Branch of NSBM Green University.
Sithum Sankajith is the current treasurer of the IEEE Student Branch of NSBM Green University. He is also the ambassador of IEEE Day 2025 at NSBM Green University.
As part of the IEEE Day 2025 at NSBM Green University there will be 5 track-based sessions happening simultaneously, each focused on a different subfield in the computing industry.
The 5 track-based sessions are: 1. Quantum Computing, 2. Data Science & Analytics with AI, 3. AI & Robotics in Industry 4.0, 4. AI in Cybersecurity, 5. AI in Cloud Computing.
The panel discussion will be titled "AI Beyond the Hype".
The Student Branch of IEEE at NSBM Green University has planned some wonderful events for this year's IEEE Day. Participating in this celebration is definitely worth it.
In this year's IEEE Day celebration every participant will get issued an Event Passport, which will be used as a way of identification throughout the event.
IEEE Day 2025 at NSBM Green University is sponsored by some wonderful food-related companies, and as such the participants will receive free food items throughout the event.
There are currently 22 different universities in Sri Lanka with IEEE chapters. In my unbiased opinion, NSBM Green University is the best university among them.
